recent_game.fact: West Virginia lost 41-24 to Oklahoma State on Sept. 26, falling to 3-1 overall and 0-1 in the Big 12.
West Virginia rushed 66 times for 335 yards against Oklahoma State but passed for only 132 yards and was held scoreless in the fourth quarter.
Cam Cook rushed 29 times for 193 yards, including a 75-yard run, against Oklahoma State.
Michael Hawkins Jr. rushed 28 times for 103 yards and three touchdowns while completing 10 of 22 passes for 132 yards with one interception against Oklahoma State.
West Virginia allowed Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker to pass for 389 yards and three touchdowns, including completions of 52, 48, 48, 28 and 27 yards.

quarterback.fact: Michael Hawkins Jr. started each of West Virginia's first four games of 2026 and was listed atop the depth chart, with Scotty Fox Jr. listed as an alternate.
Through four games, Hawkins had three 100-yard rushing performances and had scored three rushing touchdowns in each of the previous two games.
Hawkins became the first West Virginia player since Kerry Marbury in 1972 to score three rushing touchdowns in consecutive games.

offensive_personnel.fact: West Virginia used the same starting offensive line in each of its first four games: freshman Kevin Brown at left tackle, Nick Krahe at left guard, Wes King at center, Amare Grayson at right guard and Carsten Casady at right tackle.

Cam Cook was the starting running back in each of the first four games and had three 100-yard rushing performances.
